summary: Multi-account support with per-account settings, an account sidebar, per-account tray actions, and a global one-at-a-time synchronization gate.
changelog: Adds support for multiple Nextcloud accounts, each with its own synchronization, safety, and runtime settings.
Automatically migrates existing single-account configurations on first launch without losing data.
The main window gains an accounts sidebar and a per-account status, activity, and synchronization panel.
The tray shows an aggregated state and a per-account menu with Sync Now, Open Folder, and Pause actions.
Synchronizations are serialized across accounts so concurrent reconciliations do not saturate the network.
Sync failure and safety notifications identify the account that needs attention.
Extracts the debounce and cooldown scheduling into a small, tested component.
